# acli-py standup

## `acli-py standup`

Show what you changed since the last working day, and what is next for you.

"Changed" is every issue you updated since then; "next" is your open issues, most
important first.

```text
acli-py standup [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py standup
acli-py standup --output markdown | pbcopy
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--since` `TEXT` |  | YYYY-MM-DD (default: the last working day). |
| `--fields` `TEXT` |  | Columns, comma-separated: key,status,assignee,summary… or field ids (customfield_10016). |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl\|markdown]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, markdown, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |
